Index: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
===================================================================
--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -213,6 +213,10 @@
 | `POST /content/{kind}/rollback/{n}?scope=` | operator | Writes revision `n` forward as a new revision |
 | `PUT /content/priors?scope=&note=` with `Content-Type: text/csv` | operator | The priors document from the CSV a warehouse exports |
 
+Slots current GET, successful validation, PUT and rollback add `pinDiagnostics: {schema: 'slot-pin-diagnostics/v1', advisory: true, status, slotsRevision, catalog: {source, revision}, checkedAt, warningCount, omittedWarningCount, warnings}`. A candidate has null `slotsRevision`; a successful write diagnoses its exact returned document, without rereading slots. An authorized explicit document with no pins is `not_required` with catalog `not_read`, null catalog revision/time and zero counts; it is not checked-catalog assurance. Legacy GET fallback, missing/corrupt/uninitialized catalog or optional-read failure reports `unavailable` with null counts/list/catalog revision/time. New catalog reads require typed canonical-tenant catalog authority in every auth mode and exact equality with the slot document scope; unbound legacy selectors report unavailable without catalog I/O, preserving the original slot operation.
+
+Available pin feedback names the strict uncached committed catalog revision and observation time. At most50 samples use zero-based `pageIndex`/`slotIndex` and `reason: missing_piece | slot_type | currently_ineligible`; total/omitted counts include all warning occurrences, and no pin IDs or page/slot names are echoed. Current eligibility uses lifecycle, publish window and stock. These warnings do not block scheduled, draft, missing or temporarily unavailable pins, rewrite documents, or invent fallback/exclusion policy. The existing Rules screen shows current/draft checks and the original save response; History retains the original rollback response summary with a Rules link. Catalog and slots remain independent: a later catalog change can invalidate a pin, runtime refusal/reservation remains authoritative, and feedback is neither an atomic activation guarantee nor persisted receipt metadata. Historical reads and generic library writers are unchanged.
+
 Two more for the catalog, both requiring the operator token, the seam your content system connects to:
 
 | Route | Body | Does |
